# CANDIDATE: ATR_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of ATR contraction, a break of the prior 30‑min high on above‑average volume signals an imminent expansion move. This edge exists because low volatility periods often precede explosive moves, and volume confirmation helps filter false breakouts in low-VIX regimes where mean reversion is less dominant.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If 5‑min ATR < 0.5× its 20‑bar average for at least three consecutive bars, then wait for price to close above the highest high of the last six bars (prior 30‑min high) on a bar where volume > 1.8× the 20‑bar average volume; go long at the next bar open. Exit shape: Initial stop at the low of the breakout bar (or 0.4% below entry); target at 2R or trail using a Chandelier exit (ATR×3) after 1R profit. Regime hint: Works best in low‑VIX (<15) environments where contraction is meaningful; avoid high‑VIX (>25) when ATR is already elevated and breakouts often fail.
